aggregate_row_recomputation.principle: Counts, rates, completeness, and headroom rebuild from rows.

candidate_corpus_complete.principle: Completeness depends on expected authentic recheckable rows, not success rate.

candidate_rows.principle: Every model-task unit retains raw, parsed, exact, prefix, token, timing, and receipt data.

defined_model_specs.principle: Only the flagship Qwen MoE and middle Gemma MoE own headline rows.
defined_model_specs.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

duration_s.principle: Monotonic runtime makes the real workload visible.
duration_s.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

field_provenance.principle: Every field carries source, hash, reducer, and schema lineage.
field_provenance.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

frozen_task_manifest.principle: Tasks, prompts, targets, seeds, budgets, parser, and checker freeze before output.
frozen_task_manifest.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

gate_check_summary.principle: A block names the exact failed upstream, identity, row, parser, or checker value.
gate_check_summary.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

honest_verdict.principle: The conclusion separates direct evidence from any unattempted repair claim.
honest_verdict.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

inference_substrate.principle: The artifact declares local llama.cpp CUDA direct generation.
inference_substrate.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

model_level_metrics.principle: Direct rates and uncertainty derive only from retained model rows.

parse_failure_rows.principle: Missing parses remain explicit and never become invalid zero values.

per_unit_rows.principle: Every expected headline model-task unit remains available for independent replay.

preconditions_checked.principle: Inputs, cache, hardware, tools, identities, and hashes are checked before generation.
preconditions_checked.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

protected_files_unchanged.principle: The active roadmap and conductor retain their before-run hashes.
protected_files_unchanged.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

random_seed.principle: The fixed task schedule gives both models the same per-task generation seed.
random_seed.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

regeneration_headroom_count.principle: The integer is the exact size of the row-derived headroom subset.

regeneration_headroom_rows.principle: Only invalid parsed rows with a useful exact prefix enter measured headroom.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: The final content hash detects any artifact change.
reproducibility_checksum.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

status.principle: The task ends with complete evidence or one named blocking condition.
status.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

tests_run.principle: Commands, exits, and summaries show which checks ran.
tests_run.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

upstream_gate_receipt.principle: The exact Exp6648 admission field and artifact hash authorize generation.
upstream_gate_receipt.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

verdict_class.principle: The closed class follows authentic row-derived direct evidence.
verdict_class.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt

verifier_is_oracle.principle: The checker evaluates a separate proposal model and performs no intervention.
verifier_is_oracle.source: frozen task contract and direct run receipt
